dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Three prominent 'O' shaped structures exhibit irregular, high-contrast dark perimeters. The most dorsal annulus shows a diffuse gradient transition from a dark outer ring to a lighter central region. A secondary 'C' shaped structure to the posterior shows a sharper, more defined dark boundary on its leading edge.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low to moderate density of small, asymmetrical low-intensity pixel clusters. Core concentrations are highest in the central lateral region, appearing as solid dark points without discernible internal light-to-dark gradients.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the top three dorsal-lateral annuli form an irregular scalene triangle. The posterior-most annulus centroid sits at an obtuse angle relative to the two more anterior centroids.
